paragraphs.text: Azra is a creature type for a species of horned humanoids with purple, blue or dark skin that have distant demonic ancestry.
Azra share similarities with the tieflings from Dungeons & Dragons , except Azra lack a tail.
Azra appear primarily in black , though they may also appear in red .
The Azra creature type was introduced in Battlebond and has not appeared much since its introduction.

The creature type would receive cameos in other suppemenatl sets with Azra Smokeshaper in Modern Horizons and Kels, Fight Fixer in Jumpstart . The type also returned in the un-set Unfinity with the card Quick Fixer .

Due to being introduced in the supplemental product Battlebond , Azra is the only Magic-created creature type that has no cards with it as a type having ever been legal in Standard. The only other type that had this distinction was the token-based Fractal , which had a card printed in the Strixhaven: School of Mages commander side-release, Commander 2021 . Fractal got its first standard-legal card printed in March of the Machine ' s Jumpstart packs, leaving Azra as the only type to never have a card be legal in Standard.

The Azra of Kylem have a distant demonic ancestry. They have the appearance of a horned human with purple, blue or dark skin. Their horns have different shapes for different individuals. Males also have horny appendages on their chins. Their facial shape can shift into a purely demonic snarl when they feel threatened.

Wealth, taste, and trickery are the Azra's primary interests. They love anything gold and shiny and aren't afraid to show off their wealth. Thus, most Azra become merchants , though others seeking quick coin might turn to a life of crime as rogues , assassins , or mercenaries .
